描述_EN: it was part of a series entitled "the elements", and including "air", "earth", "fire" and "water". during the first quarter of the eighteenth century, allegorical scenes of gallant encounters became very popular with french painters and engravers as they reflected the free spirit of the age. this scene may have been taken from a french print engraved by nataniel parr after a drawing by nicholas lancret entitled "la terre" , and published by thomas and john bowles in london in 1752. the plaque depicts the flirtatious advances of two young men, one of them up a ladder picking an apple and offering it to a young woman, the other enjoying pleasantries with a second woman.
描述_ZN: 它是题为 "元素 "系列的一部分，包括 "空气"、"地球"、"火 "和 "水"。 在十八世纪的前四分之一，寓言式的英勇邂逅场景在法国画家和雕刻家中非常流行，因为它们反映了那个时代的自由精神。 这个场景可能取自Nataniel Parr根据Nicholas Lancret的画作雕刻的法国版画，名为 "la terre"，由Thomas and John Bowles于1752年在伦敦出版。 这块牌子描绘了两个年轻人的调情，其中一个在梯子上摘了一个苹果送给一个年轻的女人，另一个在和另一个女人寒暄。
